description: This file is an implementation of an AppDelegate class for a macOS application using WebKit. It manages application lifecycle, window creation (including headless mode), web view configuration, browser context management, and delegate methods for handling web navigation and dialogs.

classes.name: NSApplication (PlaywrightApplicationExtensions)
classes.description: Category extending NSApplication to add a method for retrieving the app delegate.

classes.name: WebViewDialog
classes.description: A custom dialog class used for handling JavaScript dialogs within WebKit views.

classes.name: BrowserAppDelegate
classes.description: Main application delegate managing windows, web views, and application lifecycle events for a macOS WebKit-based app, supporting headless operation, browser contexts, and delegate responsibilities.

methods.name: proxyConfiguration:WithBypassList:
methods.description: Constructs a proxy configuration dictionary based on server URL and bypass list.

methods.name: persistentDataStore
methods.description: Creates or returns a singleton WKWebsiteDataStore configured with specified directories and proxy settings.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Returns a WKWebViewConfiguration initialized with preferences, process pool, and data store.

methods.name: applicationDidFinishLaunching:
methods.description: Initial setup after app launch, including creating the first web view window with a delay.
